items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I never met Billy Kyle, but I used to listen to him. Billy Kyle was with the band that was led by Maxine Sullivan's husband...John Kirby.

ctx.x: Do you want to get to Billy Kyle before you get into that?

Well, Billy Kyle was... I never met Billy Kyle, but I used to listen to him. Billy Kyle was with the band that was led by Maxine Sullivan's husband...John Kirby. John Kirby had a little band they called "the biggest little band in the land," I believe. It had Charlie Shavers on trumpet, Buster Bailey was the clarinetist, Russell Procope played the alto saxophone, John Kirby of course played bass, Billy Kyle was the pianist, and the drummer was an excellent drummer with the brushes, I think he'd been formerly with…
